To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the thinking disposition literature is still in its early stages.

(a) thinking dispositions are defined in terms of a combination of affect and cognition; (b) thinking dispositions have been categorized as either cognitive-motivational or cognitive-epistemic; (c) thinking dispositions can be assessed in terms of either a person’s self-reported attitudes and beliefs or in terms of their observable behaviors; and (d) there are a variety of instructional strategies designed to foster thinking dispositions.
the thinking dispositions of the students are positively correlated to their performance in the thinking skills test.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question, What is the best way to teach students to think well?

the nature of thinking, the nature of the thinking process, the nature of thinking dispositions, and the nature of the relationship among thinking, thinking dispositions, thinking skills and thinking strategies.
the development of thinking dispositions and how they can be measured and taught.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
thinking dispositions are a group of positive, affective, and cognitive traits that are related to the ability to use thinking skills in a variety of situations.
thinking dispositions are the attitudes and motivations that underlie and influence thinking.
A thinking disposition refers to a person's tendency to use thinking skills in a particular context.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the disposition of critical thinking is an attitude of mind that disposes us to think in a particular way.
we have a lot of information about thinking dispositions but not enough.
thinking dispositions are the attitudes, values, and beliefs that affect thinking and learning, and they are dispositions toward thinking.
The main takeaway from our work is that
thinking dispositions have a great deal to do with the quality of people's thinking.
the thinking disposition literature is in need of a conceptual overhaul.
there is no one way to think about thinking dispositions.
